description: Acknowledge messages in this account's conversation with a peer through an existing message ID. Requires read scope and a stable request_id. Acknowledgement only advances; reads never mark messages automatically. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

handle.description: Peer account handle without an @ prefix

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

up_to_id.description: Positive message ID from this conversation; acknowledge messages through this ID

name: mark_direct_messages_read
